researchSection.title: Research
researchSection.subtitle: Applied AI systems, agent reliability, and evaluation.

entries.title: Trajalysis
entries.subtitle: LLM Agent Reliability & Evaluation
metaLines: Undergraduate Researcher · Capybara Science Lab, UCI
Advised by Prof. Thomas Zimmermann · April 2026–Present
entries.lead: Studying when correct localization hypotheses emerge, persist, or disappear across software-engineering agent trajectories.
entries.body: I am conducting a trajectory-level study across 50 SWE-bench Verified Mini instances using mini-swe-agent. The work extracts hypotheses from reasoning traces to classify generation, selection, and execution failures and compares four search policies on localization quality, patch correctness, hypothesis survival, and token and step cost.
entries.result: Evaluation scope: 50 SWE-bench Verified Mini instances · four search policies · trajectory-level hypothesis tracking.
entries.technology: mini-swe-agent · SWE-bench Verified Mini · Python · Agent Evaluation

entries.title: Cost-Aware Active Failure Diagnosis
entries.subtitle: Applied AI Systems Research · Summer 2026
metaLines: Research project under the guidance of Prof. Kalev Kask
entries.lead: A decision-support system for diagnosing software-service failures when the available evidence is incomplete, noisy, or misleading.
entries.body: Co-developed a leakage-controlled research pipeline spanning root-cause classification, retrieval-augmented diagnosis, and cost-aware diagnostic action selection. The study evaluates eight balanced root-cause categories across 32 independent scenarios and 384 deterministic incident variants, with six offline action-selection policies and four scenario-group cross-validation folds.
entries.result: A learned Selective RAG gate preserved the accuracy of Always-RAG on Qwen 9B (0.794 vs. 0.792) while reducing retrieval invocation from 100% to 34.4%, harmful switches from 14 to 6, and estimated sequential latency from 4.050s to 2.703s.
entries.technology: Python · RAG · Qwen · Ollama · TF-IDF · Logistic Regression · Pytest
